messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "stopping fluoxetine"
set: ["stopping fluoxetine", "wait at least 2 weeks after stopping an MAOI before starting fluoxetine", "wait at least 5 weeks after stopping fluoxetine before starting an MAOI or thioridazine", "ask doctor before stopping", "stopping suddenly may worsen condition", "stopping suddenly can be harmful", "ask your doctor before stopping the medicine", "stopping suddenly can cause unpleasant withdrawal symptoms", "inform doctor when starting or stopping antibiotic", "inform doctor when starting or stopping antifungal medication", "inform doctor when starting or stopping seizure medication", "may need to decrease dose rather than stopping suddenly", "stopping suddenly may cause increased seizures or withdrawal symptoms", "make decision with doctor rather than stopping on own", "false-positive result can continue for several days after stopping", "always talk to your doctor before stopping or switching medication"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
